items.title: Peter Schiff Warns Banks Hold “$2 Trillion in Mortgage Losses” as the 10-Year Nears 5%
items.summary: Key TakeawaysPeter Schiff says banks hold $2 trillion of unrealized mortgage losses as the 10-year yield nears 5%. Bank of America’s paper losses topped $109 billion, and its capital is the pressure point.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase announces 6th layoff round as workforce grows by over 4,800
items.summary: The banking giant has disclosed job cuts affecting over 900 positions across three states this year, even as profits and overall employment rise.

items.title: JPMorgan Chase Increases Crypto Exposure
items.summary: JPMorgan Chase (NYSE: $JPM), the largest U.S. commercial bank, has increased its exposure to cryptocurrencies.

items.title: A $14 Billion Fund Just Bought These 3 Stocks
items.summary: Key TakeawaysA fund that manages $13. 62 billion added to its stakes in JPMorgan Chase (JPM:NYSE), Advanced Micro Devices (AMD:NASDAQ), and First Solar (FSLR:NASDAQ) in Q3, its latest 13F shows.

items.title: How Much Tax Does a 70-Year-Old Owe Diversifying $500,000 in JPMorgan Stock?
items.summary: Selling a lifetime JPMorgan stake looks like a simple capital gains problem until Medicare sends its own bill two years later. One retiree's cheapest-looking exit may not be the cheapest, and the tradeoffs run deeper than the IRS.

items.title: 3 Legacy Financial Dividend Stocks That Never Go Out of Style
items.summary: A bank founded as a water company in 1799, a Newark insurer and a Wall Street giant all promise retirees rising income. Two of them quietly slashed payouts in the financial crisis, and one never flinched. Which one?

items.title: JPMorgan Names Top Engineering Stocks Amid Infrastructure Boom
items.summary: Investing.com -- JPMorgan has initiated coverage on two leading engineering and construction companies, highlighting opportunities in the ongoing U.S. infrastructure buildout. The firm identified Sterling Infrastructure and Comfort Systems as top picks in the sector, citing attractive valuations relative to future growth potential despite recent market selloffs.
